description: Config file support using YAML format. Add ability to load framework configuration from a YAML file, with CLI arguments overriding file values. Support profiles for different attack scenarios.
steps: Create posframework/config_loader.py with a ConfigLoader class that: (a) loads configuration from a YAML file (default: posframework.yaml or ~/.posframework.yaml), (b) supports a 'profiles' section for named attack configurations (e.g., stealth, aggressive, recon-only), (c) merges config file values with CLI arguments (CLI takes precedence), (d) validates configuration values with sensible defaults matching current config.py constants, (e) supports environment variable interpolation in YAML values (e.g., ${POSFW_NETWORK_GW}), (f) provides a get(key, default) method and attribute-style access.

Create a default config template file at the repo root: posframework.yaml.example with all configurable options documented with comments. Sections should include: general (interface, ap_interface, channels), recon (timeout, channel_hop_interval, status_interval), attack (deauth_burst_count, beacon_interval, rssi_limit), rogue_ap (network settings, captive portal), plugins (enabled plugins list, plugin directories), profiles (stealth, aggressive, recon-only presets with different parameter values).

Update posframework/config.py to support loading values from the config file. Add a load_config(path=None) function that uses ConfigLoader and updates module-level constants. Keep existing defaults as fallbacks.
Update posframework/__main__.py to add --config CLI argument that specifies a YAML config file path, and --profile argument to select a named profile. Load config early in main() before other setup.
acceptance_criteria: posframework.yaml.example exists at repo root with all sections documented
ConfigLoader loads YAML files and provides get(key, default) access
ConfigLoader supports profiles that override base settings
verification: python -c "from posframework.config_loader import ConfigLoader; print('ConfigLoader imported OK')"
python -c "from posframework.config_loader import ConfigLoader; c = ConfigLoader(); print(f'Default profile: {c.get(\"general.interface\", \"wlan0mon\")}')"
findings: YAML import is optional (try/except with YAML_AVAILABLE flag). ConfigLoader works without pyyaml installed, returning defaults. Verification done via direct module import (sys.path) since scapy is not available in this environment. All py_compile checks pass. Environment variable interpolation tested with os.environ. Profile overrides verified for stealth and aggressive.
